record.paper_title: Open problems from the 12th International Conference on Fuzzy Set Theory and Its Applications
record.original_question: For the smallest semicopula-based universal integral I_S(m,f)=sup_{t in [0,1]} S(t,h_{m,f}(t)), where h_{m,f}(t)=m({x in X : f(x)>=t}), characterize those semicopulas S for which the translation identity I_S(m,f+alpha)=I_S(m,f)+alpha holds for every measurable space (X,A), every capacity m on A, every measurable f:X->[0,1], and every alpha in [0,1] with f+alpha still taking values in [0,1].

evidence.quote: Problem 9.2 (O. Hutnik). Characterize a class of semicopulas S, for which the equality IS(m, f + alpha) = IS(m, f) + alpha holds for each (X,A) in S, each (m, f) in M(X,A) x F(X,A) and alpha in [0, 1] such that f + alpha in [0, 1].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{S}$ denote the class of semicopulas, i.e., binary operations $S:[0,1]^2\to[0,1]$ that are non-decreasing in each argument and satisfy $S(t,1)=S(1,t)=t$ for all $t\in[0,1]$. For a measurable space $(X,\mathcal{A})$, a capacity on $\mathcal{A}$ is a set function $m:\mathcal{A}\to[0,1]$ such that $m(\emptyset)=0$, $m(X)=1$, and $m(A)\le m(B)$ whenever $A\subseteq B$. For a measurable function $f:X\to[0,1]$ and a capacity $m$, define the survival function $h_{m,f}(t)=m(\{x\in X:f(x)\ge t\})$ for $t\in[0,1]$, and the smallest semicopula-based universal integral
$$I_S(m,f)=\sup_{t\in[0,1]} S\big(t,\,h_{m,f}(t)\big).$$
Characterize all semicopulas $S\in\mathcal{S}$ such that the translation identity
$$I_S(m,\,f+\alpha)=I_S(m,f)+\alpha$$
holds for every measurable space $(X,\mathcal{A})$, every capacity $m$ on $\mathcal{A}$, every measurable function $f:X\to[0,1]$, and every constant $\alpha\in[0,1]$ for which $f+\alpha$ still takes values in $[0,1]$.
artifact.status_search_result: A solution was provided by Boczek and Kałuszka, showing that the only semicopula for which the translation identity holds (for all measurable spaces, capacities and functions) is the Łukasiewicz t-norm $S(a,b)=\max(a+b-1,0)$. Related solutions to neighboring problems were also published.

status_evidence.title: Convergence theorems for seminormed fuzzy integrals: Solutions to Hutník's open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Solutions to Hutník's open problems on the smallest semicopula-based universal integral.
status_evidence.claim: Hutník's open problems on this integral, including translation invariance, have been addressed in subsequent work.

status_evidence.title: The smallest semicopula-based universal integrals: Remarks and improvements
status_evidence.snippet: Translation invariance with respect to constants is characterized for the smallest semicopula-based universal integral; only the Łukasiewicz t-norm yields the additive translation identity.
status_evidence.claim: The class of semicopulas for which I_S(m,f+α)=I_S(m,f)+α holds is reduced to the Łukasiewicz t-norm.
